parent_context:
9. An architect uses a single computer for her business. She uses hand-drawn sketches
to present her ideas to clients and computer-aided design (CAD) software to create
construction projects, alterations, and redevelopments.
(a) (i) State what is meant by CAD software. [1]
(ii) Outline two benefits for the architect of using CAD software. [4]
The architect often creates large graphic files that are sent via the internet.
(b) Explain the need for data compression software in storing and transferring these
large graphic files. [3]
Data loss can cause downtime, which can force the architect to pause business operations.
The impact on productivity depends on the amount of data lost as well as the time it takes
for data recovery.
(c) (i) Describe how the architect could minimize downtime if the disk system on her
computer fails. [3]
(ii) Outline two causes of data loss other than hardware failure. [4]
